name: Uso no Idol Audition o Uke ni Kita Onna no Ko-tachi ni Doko made Yareru ka
original_name: 嘘のアイドルオーディションを受けにきた女の子たちにどこまでやれるか
source:
Honestly, you really come up with some things, don't you? Holding a fake idol audition that doesn't even exist? And then posting it online? I can't believe it.

Knowing you, you weren't planning on running a proper audition, were you? You were probably thinking about asking the girls sexual harassment questions and grinning, or maybe even trying to get handsy if you could.

You even went out of your way to create a thread on the board. Everyone thinks it's a complete gut-busting thread. Or maybe a bourbon thread.

Still, you managed to gather three such cute girls. At least their characters don't seem to overlap. What they have in common is that they all want to be idols, right?

But these girls... all three seem to have some naughty secrets.

I bet you plan to enjoy those too. Doing things to the girls you couldn't say here, or making them do them.
No, I'm not jealous at all... no...

[From [url=http://www.fiction7.com/idol.html]official site[/url]]
